codeReview.summary: The skel-entry-screen feature was correctly implemented in commit 02a0bb5e and fully fulfills VAL-SKEL-001 and VAL-SKEL-018. The original commit added 647 lines across 3 files: cockpit.go (381 lines), cockpit_test.go (246 lines), and cmd/foxctl_tui/main.go (20 lines changed). Subsequent commits (skel-three-lane-resize through skel-live-refresh) expanded cockpit.go to 1502 lines with additional state and rendering for the detail lane, evidence drawer, and ask-stream features — all original tests continue to pass. The implementation is idiomatic Go, uses sync.Mutex for all mutable state, passes race detection, and passes go vet with no issues.

summary: skel-entry-screen PASSES review. The feature correctly implements the M3 walking-skeleton entry point (-screen agents flag on cmd/foxctl_tui) and the minimum-terminal-size contract (60x15 guard). Commit 02a0bb5e added cockpit.go (381 lines), cockpit_test.go (19 unit tests), and main.go changes (20 lines). All 19 original tests pass (including TestCockpitScreen_TooSmallGuardMessage, TestCockpitScreen_TooSmallAt59x15, TestCockpitScreen_TooSmallAt60x14, TestCockpitScreen_NormalAt60x15, TestCockpitScreen_NormalAt80x24, TestCockpitScreen_PhaseForcedToTooSmall, TestCockpitScreen_PhaseChangesWhenResizedAboveMinimum, TestCockpitScreen_ResumesNormalOnGrow, TestCockpitScreen_RendersLoadingPhase, TestCockpitScreen_LoadingStateContainsURL, TestCockpitScreen_ErrorStateContainsURL, TestCockpitScreen_ReadyStateRendersLanes, TestCockpitScreen_KeyMapContainsEscape, TestCockpitScreen_DefaultPhaseIsLoading, TestCockpitScreen_APIURL, TestCockpitScreen_ConcurrentAccess, TestCockpitScreen_RenderWithZeroSize, TestTooSmallMessage, TestMinTermConstants). go vet is clean. Binary builds. --help shows the documented invocation. No shared state gaps detected. No convention violations. No skill deviations. The cockpit.go file has grown to 1502 lines in subsequent commits but all original tests continue to pass — this is expected expansion within the same feature family, not a regression.
